offences.quote: Without acknowledgement of the use of a GenAI tool, you risk academic misconduct.
Submit work produced in whole or part by GenAI, either verbatim, or paraphrased, without acknowledgment, citation and referencing.
There is a risk of academic misconduct and plagiarism if you choose not to follow the University guidance on using GenAI.
This means that, when using GenAI without proper accreditation, you could inadvertently plagiarise or breach the copyright of someone’s work.
Some platforms store the interactions, which may constitute a data breach under the Data Protection Act and UK GDPR 2018.

detection.quote: It may be picked up by similarity software either from other sources or other students’ work.

outcomes.quote: Our approach to GenAI is educative, rather than punitive.
